name: Sikadur-Combiflex SG-10 P
paste:
SIKADUR-COMBIFLEX® SG-10 P: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikadur-Combiflex® SG-10 P, April 2023, Version 02.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/y/sikadur-combiflexsg-10p.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikadur-Combiflex® SG-10 P where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.01).
1.2 Product description.
    - Sikadur-Combiflex® SG-10 P is a flexible waterproofing tape based on modified flexible Polyolefin (FPO) with advanced adhesion properties. Thickness 1.0 mm.
    - The product is part of the Sikadur Combiflex® SG System.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sealing all types of joints and cracks in many different structures and applications including:
    - Tunnels and culverts
    - Hydroelectric power plants
    - Sewage treatment plants
    - Basements
    - Water retaining structures
    - Drinking water reservoirs
1.4 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Sealing of.
    - Movement joints
    - Construction joints
    - Pipe penetrations
    - Cracks
    - Building components where differential settlement is expected
1.5 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.4.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikadur-Combiflex® SG-10 P
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: High performance joint and crack sealing tape Part of the Sikadur-Combiflex® SG System
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - Drinking water AS/NZS 4020, Sikadur Combiflex® SG , ams Laboratories, Test report No. 1116525
    - Drinking water KTW, Sikadur Combiflex® SG , HY, Certificate No. K-248079-14-Ko
    - Root Resistance CEN/TS 14416, Sikadur Combiflex® SG, SKZ, Test report No. 89643/09
    - Sanitary Compliance XP P 41-250, Sikadur Combiflex® SG , CARSO, Certificate No. 16 MAT LY 108
    - Water Regulations up to 50 °C BS6920-1:2000, Sikadur Combiflex® SG, WRAS, Approval No. 1708503
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS/NZS 4020: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - BS6920-1:2000: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - DIN 53505: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Shore D Hardness (p.2).
    - EN 12311-2: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Elongation (p.2); Technical Information > Tensile strength (p.2).
    - EN12310-2: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Tear strength (p.2).
    - EN 12316-2: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Seam strength (p.2).
    - EN 12317-2: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Seam strength (p.2).
    - EN 495-5: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Foldability at low temperature (p.2).
    - EN 1928: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Watertightness (p.2).
    - EN 1847: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Technical Information > Chemical resistance (p.2).
    - EN ISO 4892-2: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Resistance to weathering (p.2).
    - EN ISO 11925-2: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Technical Information > Reaction to fire (p.2).
    - EN 13501-1: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Technical Information > Reaction to fire (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Advanced adhesion, no activation on site required
    - Highly flexible - high crack and joint bridging ability
    - Good chemical resistance
    - Weathering and UV-resistant
    - Root penetration resistant
    - Performs well within a wide range of temperatures
    - Plasticiser-free
    - Hot air weldable
    - Can be used in contact with potable/drinking water
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Modified flexible Polyolefin (FPO)
    - Appearance and colour: Flexible light grey membrane
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Length: 25 m roll
    - Width: 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 40, 50, 100, 200 cm
    - Shore D Hardness: 35 (DIN 53505)
    - Resistance to root penetration: Pass (CEN/TS 14416)
    - Tensile strength: > 12 N/mm² (EN 12311-2)
    - Tear strength: > 50 N/mm (EN12310-2)
    - Seam strength: > 300N/50 mm; > 400N/50 mm (EN 12316-2) (EN 12317-2)
    - Service temperature: -40 °C min. to +60 °C max
    - Foldability at low temperature: Passed; No cracks at -40 °C (EN 495-5)
    - Watertightness: 6 bar / 72h; Behaviour under hydrostatic pressure (EN 1928-B)
    - Chemical resistance: Tested according to EN 1847. Contact Sika Technical Services for additional information.
    - Resistance to weathering: Artificial weathering: 7500 h passed (EN ISO 4892-2/-3)
2.7 Elongation. > 650 %
    | Maximum permissible permanent | <10 % of non-adhered tape width |
    | elongation |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Note: For higher joint movement, loop tape into the gap of the joint.
    Test method printed: (EN 12311-2)
2.8 Reaction to fire.
    | Euroclass E | (EN ISO 11925-2, classification to EN 13501-1) |
2.9 System structure. Refer to Sikadur Combiflex® SG System data sheet.
2.10 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 1 roll of 25 m length; Refer to current price list for packaging variations
    - Shelf life: 36 months from date of production
    - Storage conditions: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions. Opened and unprotected rolls must be used within 2 months. Always refer to packaging.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 02.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Thickness: 1,0 mm
4.3 Application method / tools. Reference must be made to further documentation where applicable, such as relevant method statement, application manual and installation or working instructions.
4.4 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Refer to the Sikadur Combiflex® SG System Sika Method Statement and System Data Sheet.
4.5 Further information.
    - Sikadur Combiflex® SG System Data Sheet
    - Sika Method Statement: Sikadur Combiflex® SG System

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. +0 °C min. / +60 °C max. (dry conditions)
5.3 Substrate temperature. +5 °C min. / +45 °C max. (Sikadur® epoxy adhesive temperature limits apply)
5.4 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Shore D Hardness: 35 (DIN 53505)
    - Resistance to root penetration: Pass (CEN/TS 14416)
    - Tensile strength: > 12 N/mm² (EN 12311-2)
    - Elongation: Maximum permissible permanent | <10 % of non-adhered tape width; elongation; > 650 %; Note: For higher joint movement, loop tape into the gap of the joint. (EN 12311-2)
    - Tear strength: > 50 N/mm (EN12310-2)
    - Seam strength: > 300N/50 mm; > 400N/50 mm (EN 12316-2) (EN 12317-2)
    - Foldability at low temperature: Passed; No cracks at -40 °C (EN 495-5)
    - Watertightness: 6 bar / 72h; Behaviour under hydrostatic pressure (EN 1928-B)
    - Resistance to weathering: Artificial weathering: 7500 h passed (EN ISO 4892-2/-3)
5.5 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.6 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikadur-Combiflex® SG-10 P, April 2023, Version 02.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/y/sikadur-combiflexsg-10p.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety - Regulation (ec) no 1907/2006 - reach. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
